title: Invertibility of the finite-free evaluation transpose
statement: For l, E, L, ι, X, tensor presentations a and b, and ambient inputs K and M, the scalar-extended evaluation transpose homMap X (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) a b K M is an isomorphism.

source.place: Paragraph 5: finite-free basis computation of the evaluation transpose.

proof.text: Choose a finite free basis of the completed coefficient extension. After restriction of scalars, the source and target Hom complexes are finite sums of the same RHom complexes. The tensor-Hom basis identities show that the evaluation transpose and its basis-defined inverse compose to identities; exact restriction transports this isomorphism through the derived localization and the normalized tensor presentations.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph 5: finite-free basis computation of the evaluation transpose.
